compareAllTooltip: Add all models for current drug to comparison
morphineRef: Ref: Verscheijden 2021 PD insights used for target ranges.
modelParamsNote: Only blue highlighted fields are used for current model calculation
editTooltip: Edit (Remove from list and move to form)
saveScenarioTooltip: Save current patient & drug state as a case
overwriteSaveTooltip: Overwrite the currently loaded case in place
autoSavedTooltip: Working state is auto-saved to browser local storage and restored on next visit.
presetTooltip: One tap to configure. Replaces current events.
confirmDrugSwitch: Switching drug will reset current dosing events. Continue?
confirmReset: Reset current dosing and apply preset?
summaryPeakCeHelp: Maximum modeled Ce and its sampled time. This is not validated as an individual maximum effect, BIS or respiratory depression.
summaryOnsetHelp: First sampled time when Ce reaches the configured reference lower bound. This does not establish clinical analgesia.
summaryBisOnsetHelp: Time when Ce reaches the reference lower bound. BIS is not calculated.
summaryRespRiskHelp: Time above the configured Ce reference threshold, using linear interpolation between minute samples. This is not measured clinical respiratory depression.
summaryDeepSedationHelp: Cumulative time above the configured Ce upper bound. BIS and sedation depth are not calculated.
summaryRecoveryHelp: Time after the last finite infusion stop until Ce drops below the reference lower bound. Hidden while an infusion continues. This does not predict awakening.
summaryTotalDoseHelp: **Total drug delivered** over the simulated window (bolus sum + infusion × duration). Unit is shown on the card. Useful for sanity-checking against actual dosing records.
alertsStable: No calculated alert conditions were met.
alertsDisclaimer: Reference for the entire simulation window. This does not establish current safety or individual respiratory depression.
alertSustainedRespBody: Ce is at or above the reference threshold {{threshold}} ng/mL for {{minutes}} consecutive minutes. Patient-specific clinical validity is unverified.
alertSevereDepressionBody: At minute {{at}}, R/(1+R) is about {{fraction}}%, where R=Σ(Ce/configured C50). This is not validated as individual respiratory depression.
alertUndertreatmentBody: Peak Ce {{peak}} ng/mL is below the configured lower bound {{threshold}} ng/mL. This does not establish inadequate clinical analgesia.
alertInvertedWindowBody: The lower bound {{analgesia}} ng/mL exceeds the reference C50 {{resp}} ng/mL. Check differing endpoints and source populations.
alertWaningBody: At the simulation endpoint, Ce last exceeded the lower bound {{sinceMin}} minutes ago. This is not a recommendation for another dose.
sedationAdvancedCeNote: Ce derived from {{source}} (ke0 = {{ke0}}/min). Exploratory PKPD — not for clinical dosing decisions.
sedationCeUnavailableReason: Effect-site model not implemented for this drug — PD endpoints (analgesia, sedation, dissociation, EEG, hemodynamics) have endpoint-specific concentration-effect relationships and no single ke0 captures all clinical effects.
dexContextWarning: Dexmedetomidine sedation is highly context-dependent — arousal, stimulation, co-administered drugs, age, hepatic/cardiac function, and ICU illness substantially alter the clinical effect.
ketamineContextWarning: S-ketamine PK only (Noppers 2011) — racemic ketamine is not modelled; do not interpret these concentrations as total racemic ketamine. Ce intentionally not shown — see Ce N/A note for why.
ketamineHeatPainRef: Heat-pain C50 ~375 ng/mL (Sigtermans/Noppers, experimental — not a sedation/anesthesia threshold)
chartClassTooltip: Switch which drug class the main chart renders. Auto-estimated from active drugs; clicking either side records a manual override. Use the toggle to view one class at a time when both are in use.
paramUnusedNote: Current PK model uses only {{active}}. Greyed-out fields don't affect the simulation.
clockNowTooltip: Set simulation start to the wall-clock time (HH:MM). Existing events are unchanged.
burdenTooltip: Right axis: R/(1+R), R=Σ(Ce/configured C50), an unvalidated patient-specific reference index. Sedative interactions are excluded. AUCs sum raw drug-specific Ce areas, not equivalent potency. Band portion: ∫[clamp(Ce,lower,upper)−lower]dt. Above-band: ∫max(0,Ce−upper)dt.
xAxisMinTooltip: X-axis lower bound (minutes from sim start)
resetDisplayTooltip: Reset axes / time-zero / display modes to defaults (events and patient unchanged)
viewLiteratureTooltip: Show literature references for this drug's therapeutic range
noReferenceData: No literature reference data available for this drug.
provisionalWarning: Some Ce values for this drug are extrapolated or inferred — primary literature with abstract-level Ce50 was not located. Treat numeric ranges as guidance, not precision.
invalidInput: Check input: finite positive dose/duration and event time within 24 hours of the origin. Invalid changes were not applied.
calculationInvalid: Cannot calculate these patient, model or dose values. Results are paused. Check age, weight, height, model and dosing.
savedStateInvalid: Cannot load saved data. The original data is retained and auto-save is paused.
saveFailed: Cannot save this state. Check inputs and browser storage.
legacyTracesHidden: Comparison traces from an earlier calculation version are retained but hidden. Recalculate and add them again.
ceUnavailable: Ce is not calculated by this model.
modelLimitNote: Model estimates. Measured BIS, awakening and patient-specific respiratory depression have not been validated by this app.
unsourcedModelNote: These coefficients lack a clear primary source. This is a simplified reference model.
populationLimitNote: PK populations and reference-band populations differ. The displayed bands are not validated pediatric extrapolations.
patientInvalid: Patient attributes are invalid. Check age, weight and height.
infusionSeriesRequired: The existing infusion overlaps this entry, so its target series is ambiguous. Edit the intended infusion in history. Existing records are unchanged.
entrySelectionOnly: Selecting a drug does not record a dose
entryUsePumpCard: Use a pump card to change rate or restart. A new infusion is a separate pump.
entryParallelExplicit: Start an explicitly separate parallel pump
entryFutureOnly: Entries after the reference must be planned. Passing that time does not mark them as administered.
entryNoPump: Start an infusion to see its pump card.
entryNoActualRate: No entry active at the reference time
entryChangeHint: Only this pump changes. The new rate lasts until its next change.
entryStopHint: This records a zero rate for this pump. Other pumps remain unchanged.
entryNoAutoActual: Plans are never automatically marked administered
entryPastPlan: The planned time has passed. Confirm whether it was administered.
entryActualConfirm: Confirm it was actually administered before changing its status.
entryDeleteConfirm: Delete this entry? Removing a rate change recomputes the previous entered rate/stop.
entryEditingHistory: Editing history; original retained until saved
entryDraftStale: The history changed while editing. Choose the pump again. Records remain unchanged.
entryMovedToPlan: An entry moved to a future time was changed to planned.
entryActionSaved: Saved the change to the selected pump.
